name: dir-sync
description: Sync PersonalClaw state between your machines through a shared/synced folder — a cloud-sync mount, an NFS share, or a mounted USB drive. No credentials, no server: point two machines at the same folder and durability converges. The folder holds shard objects only; secrets are excluded upstream and never touch it.
author: PersonalClaw

x-meta.label: Sync folder
x-meta.help: Absolute path to the shared/synced folder both machines point at (e.g. ~/synced/personalclaw-sync or /Volumes/usb/pc-sync). Supports ~ and $VARS. Leave empty to configure later — the transport stays idle until set.
